title: Conductor position on a tower type (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. One conductor attachment point of a tower type, as a child record (params are scalars only, so a tower's positions are children, never an inner array). Carried beside the model, never used by the solver.

phase.description: The phase (or earth wire) at this position.

circuit.description: The circuit number on a multi-circuit tower.

xM.description: Horizontal offset from the tower centre line, metres (positive to one side, negative to the other).

yM.description: Height of the attachment point above ground, metres.
